category_title: Socially isolated student with ADHD who struggles with behavioral regulation and seeks adult validation
scenario_title: Whole-class instruction disturbance and peer friction
minimal_context: The teacher is explaining a task to the students during whole-class instruction.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright class, please listen while I explain what the task is.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Causes a disturbance while the teacher is explaining) Hey, what are you guys looking at back there?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jacob, please be quiet. I will repeat the sentence.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues causing a disturbance) I'm just trying to see what they are doing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am going to repeat the same sentence again so everyone can hear.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns around as several children begin to shake their heads and roll their eyes) It is not fair because I do not intentionally wish to ruin it for the others.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Alright class, please listen while I explain what the task is.

STUDENT: (Causes a disturbance while the teacher is explaining) Hey, what are you guys looking at back there?

TUTOR: Jacob, please be quiet. I will repeat the sentence.

STUDENT: (Continues causing a disturbance) I'm just trying to see what they are doing.

TUTOR: I am going to repeat the same sentence again so everyone can hear.

STUDENT: (Turns around as several children begin to shake their heads and roll their eyes) It is not fair because I do not intentionally wish to ruin it for the others.
